milestone: Prototype B B1 single-cause root-layout continuation

r2_physical_result.first_causal_blocker: mount point is not canonical: realpath(/vendor) -> /system/vendor; vendor mount returns EEXIST

first_stage_init.canonical_contract: fs_mgr_create_canonical_mount_point requires realpath(mount_point) to equal mount_point before mounting each required fstab entry.

generation_provenance.r4: PRODUCT_DEVICE=generic resolves through BoardConfigGsiCommon/MainlineCommon, setting TARGET_COPY_OUT_VENDOR=vendor and BOARD_VENDORIMAGE_FILE_SYSTEM_TYPE=ext4; BOARD_USES_VENDORIMAGE is true and create_root_structure.mk creates /vendor as a directory.
generation_provenance.r2: PRODUCT_DEVICE=ubox10_ceiling_arm64 resolves to device/generic/arm64/BoardConfig.mk; the dedicated BoardConfig does not inherit the GSI separate-vendor settings, so TARGET_COPY_OUT_VENDOR defaults to system/vendor, BOARD_USES_VENDORIMAGE is false and create_root_structure.mk creates /vendor -> /system/vendor.

peer_mountpoint_risk.product: r4 and r2 both use /product -> /system/product; identical gsi skip_mount.cfg excludes /product and descendants before MountPartition.
peer_mountpoint_risk.system_ext: r4 and r2 both use /system_ext -> /system/system_ext; identical gsi skip_mount.cfg excludes /system_ext and descendants.
peer_mountpoint_risk.oem: r4 and r2 both use a canonical /oem directory; skip_mount.cfg also excludes /oem.
peer_mountpoint_risk.odm: r4 and r2 both use a canonical /odm directory and current fstab has no /odm entry.
peer_mountpoint_risk.vendor_dlkm: r4 and r2 both use a canonical /vendor_dlkm directory for the required fstab entry.
peer_mountpoint_risk.metadata: r2 now exactly matches the accepted r4 /metadata directory contract and physically passed SwitchRoot.

allowed_semantic_delta: Replace exactly the root-level /vendor symlink in r2 system_a with the accepted r4 empty directory contract: mode 0755, uid/gid 0:2000 and SELinux u:object_r:vendor_file:s0.
